name: Shibuya Days@ ~Shibu Digi Tantei.com Series~
original_name: 渋谷DAYS＠ ～渋デジ探偵．COMシリーズ
source:
Main character is a detective. One day a girl that he admires applies to his place to search for her missing brother. She tried to investigate the case herself together with detective club friends, but they got attacked themselves as a result. With the appearance of a thief stealing paintings case expands. Where will investigation lead?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名侦探。一天，一位他仰慕的女孩前来委托他寻找失踪的弟弟。她曾与侦探社的朋友们一起调查此案，却反而遭到袭击。随着一桩盗画案浮出水面，案件进一步扩大。调查最终将走向何方？

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]）
